_comment: sogood.business is a HUB: its /sitemap.xml is a <sitemapindex> pointing at
357 tenant sites, some on their own apex domains (cuddletherapyaz.com,
guardrail.website, ttsphotography.co). Discovery expands it automatically.
Pilot shape: the cheap fast lane sweeps every tenant's homepage, while the
expensive browser lane goes deep on the first 15 sites only. Both lanes run
concurrently, so the sweep costs almost nothing in wall-clock terms.
Raise deepSites to widen the deep scan. At ~30s/page with Lighthouse on,
